name: Pathfinder
description: A pathfinding bot that learns, generates fun levels in every mode, and beats most of what you throw at it.

bot-enabled.name: Enable Pathfinder Bot
bot-enabled.description: Lets the bot take over and play the level for you.

learning-enabled.name: Online Learning
learning-enabled.description: Refines the policy from death frames in the current session.

generator-difficulty.name: Generator Difficulty
generator-difficulty.description: How spicy generated levels should be (1 = chill, 10 = demon).

generator-mode-mix.name: Generator Mode Mix
generator-mode-mix.description: Which gamemodes the level generator is allowed to use.

show-path-overlay.name: Show Planned Path
show-path-overlay.description: Draws the planned path on top of the level while the bot plays.
